drawings.extraction_notes: No drawing PDFs were staged in the project folder. All MEP system inventory is derived from calculation submittals and specification sections, not from drawing sheets. The absence of drawings is a significant gap — floor plans, demolition plans, mechanical/electrical plans would corroborate room counts, system layouts, and area figures. The folder name 'wichita_gamma_camera' may indicate that gamma camera equipment was considered (or is present on the same floor/area) but all contract documents consistently reference 'image guided catheterization laboratory' equipment — not a standalone gamma camera suite.

claims.value: Prepare Site for Cath Lab Equipment

conflict_flags.rationale: Every source document in the folder consistently refers to this as a catheterization lab (cath lab) project. The folder name 'wichita_gamma_camera' may reflect BFA's internal filing system for a related or predecessor project (gamma camera equipment is used in nuclear medicine, adjacent to cardiac cath labs in VA medical centers), OR the folder may have been misnamed. No document references a gamma camera. Using the contract project name as canonical.

claims.source: HVAC Load Calc (TRACE 700) sum of room floor areas

conflict_flags.rationale: The 1,500 SF figure is from the governing contract document and is explicitly stated as 'approximately'. The TRACE 700 load calc shows 1,638 SF as a total floor area entry for the AHU-1 system, but individual room areas in the model (99+313+412+70+205+275+275+100+100+436+415+100 = 2,800 SF listed items) suggest the 1,638 figure is a sub-system or partial zone sum, not a discrepant area. The discrepancy is within the 'approximately' qualifier and is architecturally plausible (1,500 SF net renovated vs. slightly larger served zone area). Minor severity.

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: Bowman, Foster & Associates (either PC or Inc.)
conflict_flags.rationale: Same firm, same address (Virginia Beach, VA 23462). The 'PC' vs. 'Inc.' discrepancy is likely a data entry variation within the same organization (professional corporation vs. incorporated designation). Minor severity; no factual impact on firm identity.

Section II clearly states the renovation is in 'building 2'. Section VII references buildings 24, 51, and 53 only as sources for reference/as-built drawings 'included within the limits of this project' — these appear to be adjacent buildings whose as-built drawings are provided as context for the A-E, not as buildings where construction work occurs. Minor severity.
